acceptanceCriteria: A native ubuntu-24.04 linux/amd64 run against frozen candidate bytes retains PASS reports for install lifecycle and plain-CLI nine-case host lifecycle; failed or missing runs remain FALLBACK.
The workflow and governing decision exist at the same source revision; all GitHub Actions changes receive the required owner approval.
No unrun platform is promoted: missing or failed native evidence remains FALLBACK.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, REL-01. Source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a.

Decision 0420 routes candidate-byte linux/amd64 lifecycle and plain-CLI host qualification through an owner-dispatched release-gate workflow of decision 0415. The pinned tree has neither decision 0415 nor that workflow; its only workflow_dispatch is the PR test campaign. The selected path cannot produce the evidence needed to label linux/amd64 Core, so it remains FALLBACK.

Source: docs/decisions/0420-rc1-release-policy-selections-2026-09-26.md:31; docs/specs/corvint-1.0-product-and-release-v1.md:219; .github/workflows/pr-tests-qualification.yml:3; .github/workflows/ci.yml:1

Observed checks: "At 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a, rg --files .github/workflows returned only ci.yml, ci-control-plane.yml and pr-tests-qualification.yml; rg --files docs/decisions found no 0415 entry. Native linux/amd64 run NOT_RUN."

Owning contract: "PRS-V1-004; decision 0420 item 2"

Correction: Add and review the owner-dispatched release-gate workflow or amend decision 0420 to an existing qualified path; make it consume the exact candidate archives and retain lifecycle and host-lifecycle reports with commit, tree, binary digest and runner identity.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; original reports and evidence: .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Focused checks plus independent review are required for repair; any native release qualification needs the selected candidate and owner-dispatched run. No qualification or promotion is implied by this ticket.
title: Provide the selected candidate-byte linux/amd64 qualification workflow
